notes: Clinician-administered instruments enabled after the user confirmed permission (9 Nov 2026). The model never estimates them. PHQ-9 and GAD-7 stay in the v1 registry unchanged.

instruments.label: WHODAS 2.0 (12-item)
instruments.licence_note: User confirmed permission to use this instrument (9 Nov 2026). Clinician-administered only; administer with the official form. Item labels here are short descriptors, not the official wording.

items.label: Standing for long periods
Household responsibilities
Learning a new task
Joining community activities
Emotionally affected by health problems
Concentrating for about ten minutes
Walking a long distance
Washing the whole body
Getting dressed
Dealing with people you do not know
Maintaining a friendship
Day-to-day work or school

instruments.reliable_change_source: WHO WHODAS 2.0 manual: simple sum scoring of the 12-item version (0–48); no reliable-change threshold set.

instruments.label: DSM-5-TR Level 1 Cross-Cutting Symptom Measure (adult)
instruments.licence_note: User confirmed permission to use this instrument (9 Nov 2026). Clinician-administered only; administer with the official form. Item labels here are short descriptors, not the official wording.

items.label: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
Feeling down, depressed or hopeless
More irritated, grouchy or angry than usual
Sleeping less than usual but still lots of energy
Starting more projects or doing riskier things than usual
Nervous, anxious, frightened, worried or on edge
Feeling panic or being frightened
Avoiding situations that make you anxious
Unexplained aches and pains
Feeling illnesses are not taken seriously enough
Thoughts of actually hurting yourself
Hearing things other people could not hear
Feeling someone could hear your thoughts, or hearing others' thoughts
Problems with sleep that affected sleep quality
Problems with memory or with finding your way
Unpleasant thoughts, urges or images that repeatedly enter your mind
Feeling driven to perform certain behaviours or mental acts over and over
Feeling detached from yourself, your body or surroundings
Not knowing who you really are or what you want out of life
Not feeling close to other people or enjoying relationships
Drinking at least four drinks of alcohol in a single day
Smoking or using tobacco products
Using medicines or drugs on your own or beyond prescription

instruments.reliable_change_source: DSM-5-TR Section III: a domain needs further inquiry when its highest item reaches the domain threshold; no total-score bands.

instruments.label: Altman Self-Rating Mania Scale (ASRM)
instruments.licence_note: User confirmed permission to use this instrument (9 Nov 2026). Clinician-administered only; administer with the official form. Item labels here are short descriptors, not the official wording.

items.label: Feeling happier or more cheerful than usual
Feeling more self-confident than usual
Needing less sleep than usual
Talking more than usual
Being more active than usual (socially, sexually, at work, home or school)

bands.label: at or above cut-off (≥ 6): further assessment

instruments.reliable_change_source: Altman et al. (1997), Biological Psychiatry 42(10): cut-off ≥ 6; no reliable-change threshold set.
